stock_analysis_curriculum.summary: A top-down stock analysis curriculum for the US market (NYSE/NASDAQ) covering macro analysis, sector selection, stock scanning, fundamental analysis, options strategy, and integrated practice.

top_down_approach_overview.summary: The top-down approach starts from macroeconomic analysis and narrows down to individual stocks via a 5-floor pyramid: risk assessment, macro analysis, sector identification, fundamental evaluation, and entry point selection.

macro_analysis.summary: Macro analysis covers key economic indicators (GDP, CPI, Non-Farm Payroll, ISM, Yield Curve), pain points (geopolitical tensions, banking crises), index support/resistance, and VIX sentiment levels.

economic_indicators.summary: Key macro indicators: GDP growth (expanding/shrinking), CPI/inflation (affects rate hikes and growth stocks), Non-Farm Payroll, ISM Manufacturing (>50 = expansion), Consumer Confidence, and Yield Curve (inverted = recession warning).

vix_analysis.summary: VIX measures market fear: <15 strong buy, 15-20 normal, 20-30 defensive shift, >30 potential reversal/buying opportunity, >40 crisis/panic. VIX term structure contango reversal signals immediate fear.

sector_analysis.summary: Sector analysis uses RRG charts to identify leading/weakening/lagging/improving sectors, and aligns with macro themes (AI, energy, financials, healthcare, industrials). Technical validation confirms sector strength via ETF breakouts and MA breadth.

rrg_charts.summary: Relative Rotation Graph (RRG) plots sector momentum in 4 quadrants: Leading (buy), Weakening (monitor/exit), Lagging (avoid), Improving (early opportunity). Confirmed by ETF breakouts above resistance with volume and 50/200 MA.

macro_themes.summary: Long-term macro themes: AI & Cloud (XLK: NVDA, MSFT, GOOGL), Financials (XLF: JPM, BAC), Energy (XLE), Healthcare/Aging Population (XLV: UNH, LLY), Industrials/Onshoring (XLI), Consumer Discretionary (XLY), Defensives (XLU, XLP, GLD).

scan_and_filter_stocks.summary: Stock screening reduces thousands of stocks to 10-20 candidates using Barchart (100% Buy, MA filters, volume), IV Percentile (low IV = buy options, high IV = sell options), and Finviz composite screener with fundamental+technical filters.

stock_screening_tools.summary: Barchart: 100% Buy/Strong Buy, 20-day MA above 50-day MA, volume 1.5x average, large cap >$10B. IV%: <25 buy options, 25-50 flexible, >50 sell options, >75 sell premium. Finviz: fundamental+technical composite. Filters: price >$10, USA, week performance +2%, SMA20>SMA50, volume >500K/day.

watchlist_management.summary: Build 4 watchlists: READY TO TRADE (analyzed, awaiting entry), ON RADAR (not yet eligible), EARNINGS WATCH (IV play opportunities), SECTOR ROTATION (improving sectors). Limit each to 15-20 stocks.

fundamental_analysis.summary: Fundamental analysis evaluates stock valuation via P/E, Forward P/E (<20 for growth), PEG (<1 = undervalued), P/FCF (<25), DCF, EV/EBITDA (<10-12x). Also checks for stocks near support with good fundamentals and high IV for put-selling. Volatility timing: avoid options 2-3 weeks before earnings; IV often drops 30-60% post-earnings.

valuation_methods.summary: Valuation metrics: P/E vs industry average, Forward P/E <20 for growth stocks, PEG <1 = undervalued, P/FCF <25, DCF intrinsic value, EV/EBITDA <10-12x. Best opportunities: good fundamentals near strong support with low volume decline and negative catalyst already priced in.

volatility_analysis.summary: Two volatility types: historical (20-30 day actual fluctuations) and implied (from options prices). Avoid short-term options 2-3 weeks before earnings. Post-earnings IV drops 30-60% (IV crush), making long options unprofitable. Check typical post-earnings move size (+/- %).

scan_strike_and_probability.summary: Translates analysis into options trades using Delta (0.15-0.30 for selling, ≥0.40 for buying) and Probability of Profit (POP >70% Short Put, >65% Bull Put Spread, >60% Iron Condor, >75% Covered Call). Capital rules: ≤5% per position, ≤20% per sector, 30-45 DTE. Stop loss at 2x premium; take profit at 50% max profit.

delta_and_options_greeks.summary: Delta measures option sensitivity to stock price. 0.70-0.80: deep ITM high probability; 0.50: ATM 50/50; 0.30-0.40: slight OTM balanced; 0.15-0.25: OTM low win rate; <0.15: far OTM lottery. Golden rule: sell at delta 0.15-0.30, buy at delta ≥0.40.

probability_of_profit.summary: POP thresholds by strategy: Short Put/CSP >70%, Bull Put Spread >65% with R/R ≥1:1, Iron Condor >60%, Covered Call >75% at nearest resistance, Long Call/Put uses R/R ≥2:1. Strike placed 5-10% below support. POP test requires >68% win rate for statistical significance.

capital_and_risk_management.summary: Position sizing: ≤5% of portfolio per trade. Sector diversification: ≤20% in same sector. Max 3-4 open positions for new traders. Expiration: 30-45 DTE for optimal theta. Stop loss: close at 2x initial premium. Take profit: close at 50% max profit. Fair value check before assignment.

integrated_practice_process.summary: Weekly routine: weekend review of Fed reports/RRG, early week VIX/S&P check, mid-week earnings tracking, weekend position review. 7-step checklist before entry: macro (VIX<25), sector (leading/improving), scan results, fundamentals, IV alignment, strike/POP, risk management. NVDA March 2025 case study: Sell Put $700 strike, Delta 0.25, POP 75%, DTE 38.

weekly_routine.summary: Weekend: review Fed reports, sector news, RRG charts. Early week: check VIX, S&P futures, update watchlist. During week: follow earnings calendar and sector news. Weekend: review performance, close positions at 50% profit, prepare for next week.

pre_trade_checklist.summary: 7-step pre-trade checklist: (1) Macro: VIX<25, (2) Sector: leading/improving, (3) Scan: top Barchart/Finviz, (4) Fundamental: P/E, EPS, debt, (5) IV% strategic fit, (6) Strike/POP >68% below support, (7) Risk: position <5% portfolio with clear stop loss.

nvda_case_study.summary: March 2025 NVDA example: 100% Buy signal, IV% 55% (high), Forward P/E 35x, EPS growth 120% YoY, positive FCF, testing MA50. Strategy: Sell Put $700 (below $720 support), Delta 0.25, POP 75%, DTE 38. Premium $450, target $225 gain, collateral $70,000.

vocabulary.summary: Key terms: VIX (S&P 500 30-day volatility), IV (implied volatility percentile), Delta (option price sensitivity), POP (probability of profit), DTE (days to expiration), Theta (daily time decay), RRG (relative rotation graph), IV Crush, Support/Resistance, Short Put, Iron Condor, Cash Secured Put, Covered Call.
